description: Defines the class 'MappedOutboundSignal' which represents an outbound signal mapped to an external message within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity service. The class encapsulates the original signal, an adaptable object, and an external message, providing methods for accessing these components, serialization, and equality checks.

classes.name: MappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: Final class representing an outbound signal that is mapped to an external message, wrapping the original signal, an adaptable, and an external message.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message associated with this mapped signal.

methods.name: getAdaptable
methods.description: Returns the adaptable object related to this signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets for this signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the mapped outbound signal to a JSON object, applying the provided predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for this object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of this object.
